headline:
Selling In South Metro
Sold At 96% Of Asking
turn_1: Echo, FMLS numbers for August show Henry County homes sold for about 96% of their first asking price. That's up from a year ago.
turn_3: And that held even with 397 new listings in August, up 15.7%. Homes still sold 12.5% faster than last year.
echo_line: More competition, same strong price. …Oh. So the first price is the one to get right.
source: FMLS via Simply List Atlanta, Henry County report, August 2026 · retrieved Oct 17, 2026
disclaimer: Averages across all homes sold in Henry County, not a valuation of any home. Pricing depends on each home's condition, location and comparable sales.
